subject: #281: the Jankó keys play the real scene inside the Expressions app (three PRs, CI running)
result: Landed as PRs, not yet merged: O-I#602 (kernel admits strike), QL-MEF#315 (scene discloses played_addresses + the lens-held six-row Jankó surface; voice class = nearest chromatic class over C3 with cents kept; a DECLARED instrument mapping, wayfinder 2.2), O-I#606 (app: Jankó panel, playVoices, InstrumentSession re-vendored from QL defb349). Evidence: real app test tests/native-expression-janko-browser.mjs (compose -> kernel bridge -> ql-field-host + worker -> app panel; release QL, headless Chromium): silent key = 0 strikes and voices keep decaying; sounding key (C, Mars 261.6 Hz) = 1 strike, that frequency x7.5 in the PCM the page scheduled, no voice retuned. Real-worker QL tests 9/9, unit 9/9, fmt/clippy clean, K8 census receipt regenerated. NOT claimed: no speaker output, nothing heard; latency gate unmet (press to scheduled block ~1.1 s plus 500 ms embedded lead vs p95<=30 ms: needs a low-latency playback mode); surface is in the Studio side panel not docked beside the stage; no keyboard/MIDI path; no chords/sustain semantics; 4 of 12 classes silent in the default sky. Next: low-latency playback policy + measured latency, dock the surface by the stage, keyboard/MIDI, then composition (journal record/overdub/save).
